name: wakir-external-verifier-hyperjump
description: Cross-tool parity validator for wakir-wat-manifest-v1 JSON-Schema using Node.js + @hyperjump/json-schema. Fourth validator pole alongside python-jsonschema, python-fastjsonschema, and ajv; independent implementation (Jason Desrosiers, not Ben McMahen / Ajv) gives genuine cross-library witness within the JS family without forcing a Rust/Go/Java toolchain dependency on the build host.
